summary: Complete testing of SALE product type implementation in SpotU marketplace. All 15 test cases from the review request were validated. 8 backend pytest tests passed (100%). 15 frontend/UI scenarios confirmed. 2 minor display issues found in My Products list.

minor.issue: brand/model/weight/price_per_session not included in INSERT SQL params — saved via 2 separate UPDATE queries after INSERT (3 DB ops per product creation). Not a functional bug but inefficient.
Returns 500 if request body is empty (no JSON body). Fix: add `body = {}` as default. Workaround: pass `{}` as body. Noted but not blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Sale products display '45.00 € / jour' instead of '45.00 €'. The priceLabel computation does not handle product_type === 'sale'. Fix: add `p.product_type === 'sale' ? '${price} €' : '${price} € / ${PRICING_LABELS[p.pricing_type] ?? "jour"}'`
Shows raw value 'very_good' instead of localized 'Très bon'. ProductDetailView renders item.condition_label directly without a COND_LABELS mapping (the mapping only exists in Step7Summary).

issues: Sale product price shown as '45.00 € / jour' instead of '45.00 €' — incorrect unit suffix for sale type

action_items: Fix my-products.tsx line 140: add product_type === 'sale' check to show price without '/ jour' unit
Fix ProductDetailView: add COND_LABELS mapping to display 'Très bon' instead of 'very_good' for condition_label chip
Optional: Optimize backend INSERT to include brand/model/weight/price_per_session in single SQL (3 DB ops currently)
critical_code_review_comments: my-products.tsx line 140: priceLabel = `${price} € / ${PRICING_LABELS[p.pricing_type] ?? 'jour'}` — does not handle product_type='sale'. PRICING_LABELS has no 'sale' key so fallback 'jour' always shown for sale products.
ProductDetailView: condition_label chip renders raw DB value (very_good) not localized text (Très bon). Step7Summary has COND_LABELS but ProductDetailView does not.
Backend INSERT missing brand/model/weight in params — 3 separate SQL operations on create. Consider merging into single INSERT.
